workItems.title: Schema grammar and governing projection
workItems.rationale: New pure module with marker failures, fence opacity, note splices, and checkbox reuse. Effort 5 is the new abstraction. Architecture +1 is the permanent reader every later phase calls. Tests for the grammar belong to this item.

workItems.title: Authority wiring and schema fields on bindings
workItems.rationale: Drift, parsers, spans, baselines, admission, and completion must share one expected-schema input. Effort 5 crosses those subsystems. Architecture +1 keeps schema 0 and schema 1 as concurrent record contracts without a version bump.

workItems.title: Recorded schema migration and recovery commands
workItems.rationale: Adds a lineage kind, digest-bound operator and reviewer authority, and idempotent registration for both unbound approvals and drift-blocked runs. Effort 8 is that migration. Architecture +2 is the lasting record kind and the two authority modes on top of the existing store.

workItems.title: Schema 1 workflow assets and rendered instruction
workItems.rationale: Publishes the skeleton, skills, templates, diagnostics, and override behavior across harness install and both delegation modes. Effort 5 matches that asset surface, including the required upgrade and skill acceptance suite. Architecture +1 is the new supported migration skill.

Tests belong to the work item they validate. No negative architecture delta is claimed. Schema 0 support is retained on purpose, so this feature does not simplify away an existing path.

### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 4
- Production files: 42
- Persistent/external boundaries: 2
- New shared abstractions or public contracts: 1
- New persistent schemas: 1

Subsystems are the plan-document projection, review governance and records, the migration commands, and shipped workflow assets. The production-file count is the Files Touched table. The two boundaries are the existing RecordStore streams and Git commit blobs. There is no new external service. The new abstraction is `loadPlanDocument`. The new persistent schema is the `plan-schema-migration` budget payload. Optional binding fields extend the version-1 payload and are not a second schema and not a SQLite migration. Phase 0 reconciles the file count if a cited module has moved. A new lock, a new stream, or a binding version bump requires this plan to be revised before that work is coded.
